fixture_selection: Fixture A only; the canonical baseline configuration after AUD-01..AUD-04. Fixture B is excluded because the external audit found its sole 20% chamber-length variation insufficiently distinct.
selection_rationale: Select the canonical baseline by definition, not by comparing regenerated outcomes. The existing A/B artifacts are superseded and are not acceptance evidence.
horizon_policy: Run and persist all 20 complete 360-degree cycles; no early stop when a detector classifies. This is a fixed prospective horizon, separate from the result and detector thresholds.
restart_policy: At the terminal cycle-3 snapshot, reconstruct from the committed fixture, restore the exact snapshot, advance one full cycle, and require exact full-snapshot equality with the continuous run.
threshold_policy: Use the existing committed detector thresholds and three consecutive valid comparisons unchanged; report PASS, FAIL, and INVALID distinctly.
rejected_step_policy: Record every rejected trial with angle, attempted step and reason before halving; preserve all accepted-step traces.
acceptance_scope: Synthetic and CONDITIONAL_ON_P4 only. This run cannot promote P4/P5-P8, establish experimental validation, or accept the Commercial Core.
